title: Grid
description:
## **Acceptance Criteria** 

Storybook Stories have been created

* Grid with four cards with title aligned on left (plain - ratio 4:3 - landscape - default size)
* Grid with four cards with title aligned on left (outlined - No image - linked - default size)
* Grid with three cards with title aligned on center (haptic - ratio 1:1 - landscape - no actions - large size)
* Grid with three cards with title aligned on center (plain - ratio 16:9 - portrait - title only - large size) 

‌

## **Technical Details** 

### **blocks/BlockCmsCardGrid/BlockCmsCardGrid.vue**

```
export interface CardGridProps {
  title? : string;
  columns : 3 | 4;
  alignment? : 'left' | 'center';
  cards : Card[];
}
```

* in three column grid, cards are large by default 
* headings have maxwidth in different viewports
* use `.container` class 
* use `LuiText` and `LuiCard` components 
* (Put image files into packages/ui/playground/.storybook/public/placeholders)
summary: A responsive card grid layout arranging content cards in 3 or 4 column configurations with consistent spacing.
features: Responsive grid adapting from 1-4 cards per row based on screen size
Automatic card sizing (large for 3-column, default for 4-column)
Optional section title with responsive max-width constraints
Container-based layout with configurable content alignment
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Card Grid component enables website visitors to browse multiple content options in a responsive grid layout. By presenting information in visually organized columns, users can quickly compare options and select content of interest, increasing engagement through digestible content presentation.

## Use Cases

- Display 1-4 cards per row depending on screen size with responsive column layouts
- Present category previews, product collections, or featured content sections
- Create content comparison layouts where users evaluate multiple options simultaneously
- Build landing page sections that highlight important content with visual hierarchy

## Design Rationale

The component supports two column configurations (3 and 4) to balance content density with readability. Three-column layouts automatically use larger cards for increased visual impact, while four-column layouts optimize for displaying more items. The alignment options and optional section title provide flexibility for different content contexts while maintaining consistent spacing and accessibility standards.
